expect.note: the paid campaign freezes and enforces aggregate USD, token, planner-call, and wall-clock stop lines before another POST

provenance: M44 zero-spend preflight on 2026-08-30 found that the 252-run campaign froze only a completed-USD stop and client wall clock. Its report already totals tokens and planner calls, but execute() never consulted either total before submitting the next paid run. A pathological provider response could therefore consume the full per-run token allowance repeatedly until the USD stop happened to catch it, while a pricing/accounting defect could leave planner calls unbounded at the campaign layer. This invariant is synthetic and makes no network, browser, or model call. It requires finite positive token and planner-call stops in campaign_start, exact recovery matching, and a pre-submit stop when any aggregate reaches its limit; one delivered run may still cross a limit, which remains a declared limitation rather than an absolute-cap claim.

triage.note: The campaign exposed aggregate token and planner-call totals but no invariant or execution branch bounded them. Watched red as unknown_check before implementation.
